name: Banh cuon with shrimp ruoc
summary: Bánh cuốn ruốc tôm is a rice sheet with no filling, eaten with shrimp ruốc, thin cucumber, herbs, and nước lèo. Du khách, the Quảng Trị visitor desk, names it as a morning plate and says it is not the Hanoi roll.
origin: Quảng Bình, on the 29 May 2024 Du khách list, crediting VCT News. A Đồng Hới street was not printed.
texture: The same article says the sheet is rice batter spread thin, with no filling inside.
howToEat: Eat it in the morning with shrimp ruốc, thinly cut cucumber, herbs, and nước lèo. A filling was not part of this roll.
A house number was not printed. The hour beyond morning, and the price, are Check on arrival.
where: A street in Đồng Hới was not printed. Ask in the morning. The address is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Banh cuon ruoc tom — the Dong Hoi rice sheet
